generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated palette-and-material clue for a character-gallery card
Primary request: create one premium 3D specimen showing the exact purple color and soft-matte surface of the Grok material in Image 1, presented as a material swatch only.
Subject: a single softly curved rounded-square sample tile of smooth matte polymer, with a small beveled edge that reveals thickness; simple abstract sample, not a character body.
Style/medium: refined soft 3D product illustration with understated micro-roughness and clean silhouette.
Composition/framing: centered, fully visible, about 70% of a square canvas, similar isolated framing to Image 1.
Lighting/mood: gentle studio lighting, broad soft highlight, no glossy glare.
Color palette: saturated lavender-violet purple matching the reference surface.
Materials/textures: soft matte finish, velvety micro-roughness, no fibers or fabric weave.
Constraints: transparent background with true alpha; no ground plane, cast shadow, eyes, face, limbs, accessories, orb, character, text, logo, frame, or UI.
